raw_bytes: All task originals are untouched and archived with SHA256. Selected evidence, report, manager and corpus index blobs must equal raw working bytes. Product source text retains existing LF attributes; its raw bytes are also archived.
local_only: Unselected scratch/bootstrap and repeated raw command files remain local at original paths; their bytes are tracked in raw-evidence.zip. Stage/commit receipts and process/session logs remain local and may be removed by later cleanup. Archive is not a restoration instruction.
whitespace_policy: Run ordinary staged diff --check. If only preserved raw corpus CRLF/JSON indentation is flagged, verify every warned line has no spaces/tabs before CRLF and run the unmodified check for all other paths; keep audit receipts locally. Do not rewrite corpus or attributes to silence warnings.
scope: No timing caches, old untracked files, engine, other operator changes or unrelated memories are staged.
